title: Why VLOOKUP Breaks When a Column Is Inserted, and the Fix
title_alts: XLOOKUP Matches Two Sheets by Column Name, Not Column Number
Stop Hardcoding Column Numbers in Your Lookup Formulas
description_hook: A VLOOKUP that worked yesterday returns #N/A or the wrong row today, and the only thing that changed is one inserted column. Here is the cause, and the exact build that cannot shift.

characters.name: the two sheets on one desk
characters.description: a laptop showing a spreadsheet beside a printed copy of a second sheet on a pale wooden desk, morning daylight, one red error cell always visible on the screen

scenes.narration: Your VLOOKUP worked yesterday. Today the same column returns #N/A.
scenes.caption: कल VLOOKUP चल रहा था। आज वही कॉलम #N/A दिखा रहा है।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a pale wooden desk showing a spreadsheet, one cell in the last column displaying the red error text #N/A, morning daylight from a window on the left.

scenes.narration: Nothing changed in your data. Someone inserted one column upstream.
scenes.caption: डेटा में कुछ नहीं बदला। किसी ने ऊपर एक कॉलम जोड़ दिया।
scenes.image_brief: The same spreadsheet with a narrow empty column newly wedged between two filled data columns, the empty column shaded yellow, cool office ceiling light.

scenes.narration: Or worse, it still returns a value. The wrong value.
scenes.caption: या इससे बुरा, जवाब आता है — पर गलत जवाब।
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet where a lookup column shows tidy prices with no error at all, one of those prices marked with a red circle, daylight on the screen.

scenes.narration: Prices from the wrong product. Names lifted from the wrong row.
scenes.caption: गलत प्रोडक्ट का दाम। गलत पंक्ति से उठाया गया नाम।
scenes.image_brief: Two printed spreadsheet pages side by side on a desk, a red line drawn from a product name on the left page to a mismatched price on the right page, warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: The formula did not break. It did exactly what you wrote.
scenes.caption: फॉर्मूला टूटा नहीं। उसने ठीक वही किया जो आपने लिखा था।
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet formula bar showing a VLOOKUP formula, the cell below it holding a value, the sheet otherwise calm and error free, even daylight.

scenes.narration: VLOOKUP takes four arguments. The third one causes all of this.
scenes.caption: VLOOKUP में चार आर्गुमेंट होते हैं। सारी गड़बड़ तीसरे से होती है।
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet formula bar with a VLOOKUP formula split into four labelled parts, the third part underlined in red, soft desk light.

scenes.narration: That third argument is a plain number, a column index.
scenes.caption: वह तीसरा आर्गुमेंट सिर्फ एक संख्या है, कॉलम इंडेक्स।
scenes.image_brief: A whiteboard with the numeral 4 written large and the words column index number beneath it, bright room light.

scenes.narration: It counts columns rightward from the first column of your range.
scenes.caption: यह आपकी रेंज के पहले कॉलम से दाईं ओर कॉलम गिनता है।
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet range outlined in blue with the numbers one, two, three and four chalked above its four columns, starting at the left edge of the outline, daylight.

scenes.narration: It knows nothing about the sheet's actual column letters.
scenes.caption: शीट के असली कॉलम अक्षरों से इसका कोई लेना-देना नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet header strip showing the column letters C, D, E and F greyed out, while small counting numbers sit inside the data area below them, flat office light.

scenes.narration: You wrote 4. So VLOOKUP returns the fourth column. Always.
scenes.caption: आपने 4 लिखा। तो VLOOKUP हमेशा चौथा कॉलम ही लौटाएगा।
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet with the fourth column of a highlighted range glowing and an arrow pointing into it from a formula bar, evening lamp light on the desk.

scenes.narration: Now a colleague inserts a column inside that same range.
scenes.caption: अब कोई साथी उसी रेंज के भीतर एक कॉलम जोड़ देता है।
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet right-click menu open over a column header with the Insert option highlighted, the surrounding data visible, cool monitor light.

scenes.narration: Excel shifts every column after it one step right.
scenes.caption: एक्सेल उसके बाद के हर कॉलम को एक कदम दाएँ सरका देता है।
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet with three data columns each carrying a small arrow showing them moved one position to the right, an empty column at their left, daylight.

scenes.narration: It even widens your range reference automatically, trying to help.
scenes.caption: मदद के इरादे से वह आपकी रेंज रेफरेंस भी अपने-आप बढ़ा देता है।
scenes.image_brief: A formula bar showing a range reference that now covers one extra column, the widened part shaded green, soft daylight on the screen.

scenes.narration: But a 4 is not a reference. It cannot shift.
scenes.caption: पर 4 कोई रेफरेंस नहीं है। वह सरक नहीं सकता।
scenes.image_brief: A whiteboard where a range reference has an arrow moving it sideways, while the numeral 4 beside it sits inside a locked padlock outline, bright room light.

scenes.narration: So column 4 now holds whatever column 3 held before.
scenes.caption: इसलिए कॉलम 4 में अब वही है जो पहले कॉलम 3 में था।
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet range with counting numbers above the columns, the fourth position now containing a column of dates instead of prices, daylight.

scenes.narration: That is the wrong-value case. Nothing errors, nothing warns you.
scenes.caption: यही गलत जवाब वाला मामला है। न एरर, न कोई चेतावनी।
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet output column filled with clean plausible numbers, no error markers or warning triangles anywhere on the sheet, calm daylight.

scenes.narration: The #N/A case is simpler. Excel found no matching key.
scenes.caption: #N/A वाला मामला आसान है। एक्सेल को मेल खाती कुंजी नहीं मिली।
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet with a column of #N/A results beside a list of product codes, and a source list nearby whose codes clearly differ, cool screen light.

scenes.narration: Three problems cause nearly every #N/A. Check all three first.
scenes.caption: लगभग हर #N/A की तीन वजहें हैं। पहले तीनों जाँचें।
scenes.image_brief: A sticky note pad on a desk with three short numbered lines written on the top note, beside a keyboard and a screen showing a spreadsheet, morning light.

scenes.narration: One: trailing spaces. Delhi with a space is not Delhi.
scenes.caption: एक: पीछे लगी खाली जगह। स्पेस वाला दिल्ली अलग गिना जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two spreadsheet cells stacked, both reading Delhi, the upper one showing a visible extra blank gap after the word marked by a red dot, daylight.

scenes.narration: Two: a key stored as text. Excel sees 1004 differently.
scenes.caption: दो: टेक्स्ट में सहेजी गई कुंजी। एक्सेल 1004 को अलग मानता है।
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet column of codes where some entries sit left aligned with small green corner triangles and others sit right aligned, cool monitor light.

scenes.narration: Three: your key sits right of the range's first column.
scenes.caption: तीन: आपकी कुंजी रेंज के पहले कॉलम के दाईं ओर है।
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet range outlined in blue whose leftmost column holds dates, while the product code column sits two positions further right, daylight.

scenes.narration: VLOOKUP searches the leftmost column only. That is not adjustable.
scenes.caption: VLOOKUP सिर्फ सबसे बाएँ कॉलम में खोजता है। यह बदला नहीं जा सकता।
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet range with only its first column lit up and the remaining columns dimmed, a small padlock drawn over the first column header, desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: Also check your Excel version before you start. XLOOKUP needs Microsoft 365.
scenes.caption: शुरू करने से पहले एक्सेल संस्करण देखें। XLOOKUP को Microsoft 365 चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: An Excel account information panel on a monitor listing the product version, the version line highlighted, cool office light.

scenes.narration: No XLOOKUP? INDEX and MATCH work in every version. Same outcome.
scenes.caption: XLOOKUP नहीं है? INDEX और MATCH हर संस्करण में चलते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A notepad on a desk with two formula names written one under the other, XLOOKUP and INDEX with MATCH, joined by an equals sign between them, warm light.

scenes.narration: Open the sheet that needs the answers filled in.
scenes.caption: वह शीट खोलें जिसमें जवाब भरने हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing a workbook with two sheet tabs at the bottom, the second tab active and its answer column empty, morning daylight.

scenes.narration: Go to the source sheet and select the whole data block.
scenes.caption: स्रोत शीट पर जाएँ और पूरा डेटा ब्लॉक चुनें।
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet with a large rectangular block of rows and columns selected, the selection border clearly drawn around headers and data, cool screen light.

scenes.narration: Press Ctrl plus T. Confirm the header row checkbox.
scenes.caption: Ctrl और T दबाएँ। हेडर पंक्ति का बॉक्स टिक करें।
scenes.image_brief: A small Create Table dialog box open over a selected spreadsheet range, its My table has headers checkbox ticked, even office light.

scenes.narration: Excel converts that block into a real Table object.
scenes.caption: एक्सेल उस ब्लॉक को असली टेबल में बदल देता है।
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet block now styled as a banded table with filter arrows in every header cell, daylight from a window at the right.

scenes.narration: Rename it under the Table Design tab. Call it Master.
scenes.caption: टेबल डिज़ाइन टैब में नाम बदलें। इसे Master कहें।
scenes.image_brief: The Table Design ribbon tab open with the table name box showing the word Master being typed into it, cool monitor light.

scenes.narration: Repeat on the target sheet. Name that table Report.
scenes.caption: लक्ष्य शीट पर यही दोहराएँ। उस टेबल का नाम Report रखें।
scenes.image_brief: A second spreadsheet sheet also styled as a banded table, its table name box reading Report, daylight on the desk.

scenes.narration: Table columns are addressed by name now, not by letter.
scenes.caption: अब टेबल के कॉलम नाम से पुकारे जाते हैं, अक्षर से नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A formula bar showing a structured reference made of a table name and a bracketed column name, the grey column letters above dimmed, soft light.

scenes.narration: Insert a column inside a table? Every name still resolves.
scenes.caption: टेबल के भीतर कॉलम जोड़ें? हर नाम फिर भी सही जगह पहुँचता है।
scenes.image_brief: A banded table with a fresh empty column inserted in the middle, the surrounding formulas still showing values and no error markers, cool light.

scenes.narration: That single change removes most of the shifting risk immediately.
scenes.caption: यह एक बदलाव ही सरकने का ज़्यादातर खतरा हटा देता है।
scenes.image_brief: A whiteboard with a column number crossed out in red and a bracketed column name written beside it in blue, bright room light.

scenes.narration: Next, clean both key columns. Dirty keys defeat everything.
scenes.caption: अब दोनों कुंजी कॉलम साफ करें। गंदी कुंजियाँ सब बेकार कर देती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Two spreadsheet key columns side by side, several entries showing ragged spacing and inconsistent alignment, desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: Add a helper column beside each key column.
scenes.caption: हर कुंजी कॉलम के बगल में एक सहायक कॉलम जोड़ें।
scenes.image_brief: A table with one new empty column added directly to the right of the key column, its header cell reading Clean Key, daylight.

scenes.narration: Type equals TRIM and the key cell. Stray spaces disappear.
scenes.caption: बराबर TRIM और कुंजी सेल लिखें। फ़ालतू खाली जगह हट जाएगी।
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet formula bar containing a TRIM formula and the cell below it showing a neatly spaced product code, cool monitor light.

scenes.narration: Numbers stored as text? Wrap that TRIM inside VALUE too.
scenes.caption: संख्याएँ टेक्स्ट में हैं? उस TRIM को VALUE के अंदर भी लपेटें।
scenes.image_brief: A formula bar showing a VALUE function wrapped around a TRIM function, the result cell now right aligned as a number, daylight.

scenes.narration: Copy the helper down both sheets, to the very last row.
scenes.caption: दोनों शीट में सहायक कॉलम आखिरी पंक्ति तक नीचे कॉपी करें।
scenes.image_brief: A long spreadsheet column of cleaned codes filled all the way to the final data row, the row number visible at the bottom edge, cool light.

scenes.narration: Click the first output cell on the Report sheet.
scenes.caption: Report शीट पर पहला नतीजा सेल क्लिक करें।
scenes.image_brief: A table on the report sheet with the first cell of the empty result column selected and outlined, morning daylight.

scenes.narration: Type equals XLOOKUP and open the bracket.
scenes.caption: बराबर XLOOKUP लिखें और कोष्ठक खोलें।
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet cell with the beginning of an XLOOKUP formula typed in and the function argument tooltip showing below it, cool screen light.

scenes.narration: Argument one: the cleaned key on this row.
scenes.caption: पहला आर्गुमेंट: इस पंक्ति की साफ की गई कुंजी।
scenes.image_brief: A partly typed XLOOKUP formula whose first argument points at a cleaned key cell in the same row, that cell outlined in colour, daylight.

scenes.narration: Argument two: the cleaned key column inside Master.
scenes.caption: दूसरा आर्गुमेंट: Master के भीतर साफ किया कुंजी कॉलम।
scenes.image_brief: The formula continuing with a second argument that selects an entire cleaned key column on the master table, the whole column outlined, cool light.

scenes.narration: Argument three: the Master column you actually want returned.
scenes.caption: तीसरा आर्गुमेंट: Master का वह कॉलम जो आप वापस चाहते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: The formula continuing with a third argument selecting the price column on the master table, that column outlined in a different colour, daylight.

scenes.narration: Argument four: the words not found, wrapped in quotes.
scenes.caption: चौथा आर्गुमेंट: उद्धरण चिह्नों में लिखा हुआ not found।
scenes.image_brief: A formula bar where the fourth argument is the quoted text not found, the quotation marks clearly visible, cool monitor light.

scenes.narration: Argument five: zero. Zero forces an exact match.
scenes.caption: पाँचवाँ आर्गुमेंट: शून्य। शून्य पूरा-पूरा मेल ज़रूरी बनाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A formula bar ending with a comma and the digit zero, and a small dropdown list beside it showing exact match as the selected option, daylight.

scenes.narration: Close the bracket. Press Enter. Read what comes back.
scenes.caption: कोष्ठक बंद करें। एंटर दबाएँ। जो लौटे उसे पढ़ें।
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet cell now displaying a returned price value, the completed formula visible in the bar above, warm desk light.

scenes.narration: Notice what is missing here. There is no column number.
scenes.caption: ध्यान दें कि क्या गायब है। कोई कॉलम संख्या नहीं है।
scenes.image_brief: A completed XLOOKUP formula in the formula bar with every argument made of names and ranges, and an empty red circle drawn on blank space beside it, daylight.

scenes.narration: Argument three is a reference, so it travels when columns move.
scenes.caption: तीसरा आर्गुमेंट रेफरेंस है, कॉलम हिलें तो वह साथ चलता है।
scenes.image_brief: A table where the price column has moved two positions right, with an arrow showing the formula reference following it, cool light.

scenes.narration: Double-click the fill handle to run it down the column.
scenes.caption: फिल हैंडल पर दो बार क्लिक करें, फॉर्मूला नीचे तक भर जाएगा।
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet cell with the small square fill handle at its lower right corner, and the column below already filling with returned values, daylight.

scenes.narration: Older Excel 2016? Equals INDEX, answer column, comma, MATCH, key, key column, zero.
scenes.caption: पुराना Excel 2016? बराबर INDEX, जवाब कॉलम, MATCH, कुंजी, कुंजी कॉलम, शून्य।
scenes.image_brief: A formula bar holding an INDEX formula with a MATCH function nested inside it, the nested part shaded, cool office light.

scenes.narration: MATCH locates the row. INDEX returns the value sitting there.
scenes.caption: MATCH पंक्ति ढूँढता है। INDEX वहाँ रखा मान लौटाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A table with one row highlighted across its width and a single cell in that row outlined more strongly, arrows pointing to both, daylight.

scenes.narration: XLOOKUP's fourth argument already turned #N/A into readable text.
scenes.caption: XLOOKUP का चौथा आर्गुमेंट #N/A को पढ़ने लायक शब्दों में बदल चुका है।
scenes.image_brief: A result column where the failures read as the plain words not found instead of error codes, the rest showing prices, cool screen light.

scenes.narration: Using INDEX and MATCH? Wrap the whole formula in IFNA.
scenes.caption: INDEX और MATCH चला रहे हैं? पूरे फॉर्मूले को IFNA में लपेटें।
scenes.image_brief: A formula bar showing an IFNA function enclosing an INDEX and MATCH formula, with a quoted fallback message at the end, daylight.

scenes.narration: Now count the misses. Run COUNTIF across the output column.
scenes.caption: अब चूकें गिनें। नतीजा कॉलम पर COUNTIF चलाएँ।
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet cell below a result column containing a COUNTIF formula, its answer showing a small whole number, cool monitor light.

scenes.narration: Count the cells reading not found, then chase each one.
scenes.caption: not found लिखे सेल गिनें, फिर हर एक की जाँच करें।
scenes.image_brief: A filtered result column showing only the rows that read not found, their key codes visible beside them, desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: Spot-check three rows by eye against the source table.
scenes.caption: स्रोत टेबल से मिलाकर तीन पंक्तियाँ अपनी आँखों से जाँचें।
scenes.image_brief: Two spreadsheet windows arranged side by side with three matching rows highlighted in the same colour across both, daylight.

scenes.narration: Then run the real test. Insert a column inside Master.
scenes.caption: अब असली परीक्षा। Master के भीतर एक कॉलम जोड़ें।
scenes.image_brief: The master table with a new empty column being added in the middle of its data, the neighbouring columns shifting right, cool light.

scenes.narration: Right-click any column header there and choose Insert.
scenes.caption: वहाँ किसी कॉलम हेडर पर दायाँ क्लिक करें और Insert चुनें।
scenes.image_brief: A context menu open over a table column header with Insert highlighted and a submenu showing Table Columns to the Left, office light.

scenes.narration: Answers unchanged? Then the formula survived. That was the point.
scenes.caption: जवाब वैसे ही हैं? फॉर्मूला टिक गया। यही तो मकसद था।
scenes.image_brief: A report result column showing exactly the same values as before, with the newly inserted empty column visible on the master table nearby, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: Some jobs this will not fix. Recognise them early.
scenes.caption: कुछ काम इससे ठीक नहीं होंगे। उन्हें जल्दी पहचान लें।
scenes.image_brief: A notepad on a desk headed with the words stop here, three blank bullet lines beneath it, low evening lamp light.

scenes.narration: Duplicate keys are the first one, and the nastiest.
scenes.caption: दोहरी कुंजियाँ पहली दिक्कत हैं, और सबसे खराब भी।
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet key column where the same invoice number appears twice in different rows, both occurrences shaded red, cool monitor light.

scenes.narration: XLOOKUP returns one match only, the first it finds.
scenes.caption: XLOOKUP सिर्फ एक मेल लौटाता है, जो पहले मिल जाए।
scenes.image_brief: A table with two identical key rows, an arrow reaching only the upper row while the lower row is greyed out, daylight.

scenes.narration: Two invoices sharing one number? You lose one, silently.
scenes.caption: एक ही नंबर के दो बिल? एक चुपचाप छूट जाएगा।
scenes.image_brief: Two printed invoices on a desk carrying the same invoice number, one of them face down, warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: Fix the keys first, or stop and pick another tool.
scenes.caption: पहले कुंजियाँ सुधारें, वरना रुककर दूसरा औज़ार चुनें।
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet key column being edited so that duplicate codes gain distinct suffixes, the edited cells shaded green, daylight.

scenes.narration: Many rows matching many rows is not a lookup at all.
scenes.caption: कई पंक्तियों का कई पंक्तियों से मेल लुकअप नहीं होता।
scenes.image_brief: A whiteboard with two vertical lists of rows and many crossing lines drawn between them, bright room light.

scenes.narration: That is a join. Power Query handles joins properly.
scenes.caption: वह जॉइन है। Power Query जॉइन ठीक से संभालता है।
scenes.image_brief: A Power Query merge dialog on a monitor with two table names listed and a join kind dropdown open, cool office light.

scenes.narration: Refreshing the same files weekly? Build the merge in Power Query.
scenes.caption: हर हफ्ते वही फाइलें ताज़ा करते हैं? मर्ज Power Query में बनाएँ।
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet Data ribbon tab with the Refresh All button highlighted and a query list panel open at the right, daylight.

scenes.narration: Half a million lookup formulas will make the file crawl.
scenes.caption: पाँच लाख लुकअप फॉर्मूले फाइल को रेंगने पर मजबूर कर देंगे।
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet status bar reading calculating with a progress indicator, an enormous grid of formula cells behind it, cool screen light.

scenes.narration: Never paste values over your lookups just to speed things up.
scenes.caption: रफ्तार के लिए अपने लुकअप पर वैल्यू कभी पेस्ट न करें।
scenes.image_brief: A paste special menu open over a result column with Values selected, and a red cross drawn over the menu, desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: The audit trail dies the second you do that.
scenes.caption: ऐसा करते ही जाँच का सारा सुराग खत्म हो जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet cell holding a bare number with an empty formula bar above it, the neighbouring cells still showing formulas, daylight.

scenes.narration: And when two systems name things differently, no formula rescues you.
scenes.caption: और जब दो सिस्टम नाम अलग रखते हैं, कोई फॉर्मूला नहीं बचाएगा।
scenes.image_brief: Two printed reports on a desk listing the same customer under two different spellings, both spellings underlined, warm light.

scenes.narration: Do one thing today. Open your worst-behaved workbook.
scenes.caption: आज एक काम करें। अपनी सबसे बिगड़ी वर्कबुक खोलें।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a desk showing a cluttered workbook with several error cells scattered through it, morning daylight.

scenes.narration: Convert one range into a Table, then name it Master.
scenes.caption: एक रेंज को टेबल में बदलें, फिर उसका नाम Master रखें।
scenes.image_brief: A selected spreadsheet range turning into a banded table with its name box reading Master, bright daylight on the desk.

title: Fix a Hand-Formatted Word Document With Styles
title_alts: Word Styles: One Change That Reformats Every Heading
Stop Formatting Word Documents One Line At A Time
description_hook: Inconsistent headings, stray spacing and text that will not align all come from the same habit: formatting by hand. Here is the cleanup order that fixes an inherited Word document with styles instead.

characters.name: the inherited document
characters.description: a laptop and a small stack of printed pages on a wide wooden desk, soft daylight, one notebook and pen always beside them

scenes.narration: You open a document somebody else made. Nothing lines up.
scenes.caption: दूसरे का बनाया दस्तावेज़ खोलिए। कुछ मेल नहीं खाता।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a wide wooden desk in soft daylight, its screen showing a word processor document whose headings are all different sizes and whose margins are uneven

scenes.narration: The first heading is bold and huge. The second one is not.
scenes.caption: पहला शीर्षक मोटा और बड़ा है, दूसरा बिल्कुल वैसा नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: The same laptop screen in soft daylight showing two section headings stacked on one page, the upper one very large and bold, the lower one small and plain

scenes.narration: One paragraph uses one font. The very next one uses another.
scenes.caption: एक पैराग्राफ़ में एक फ़ॉन्ट, अगले में कोई दूसरा।
scenes.image_brief: Two neighbouring paragraphs of text on the laptop screen on a wide wooden desk in soft daylight, each paragraph set in a visibly different typeface

scenes.narration: Bullets sit at three different indents on one single page.
scenes.caption: एक ही पेज पर बुलेट तीन अलग-अलग जगह से शुरू होते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A bulleted list on the laptop screen where three groups of bullet points each begin at a different distance from the left margin, soft daylight

scenes.narration: You fix one line, and the page break jumps somewhere else.
scenes.caption: एक पंक्ति सुधारी, और पेज ब्रेक कहीं और खिसक गया।
scenes.image_brief: A printed page beside the laptop on a wide wooden desk in soft daylight, showing a sentence cut in half at the bottom edge and continuing on the next sheet

scenes.narration: Every one of those problems traces back to one single habit.
scenes.caption: ये सारी दिक्कतें एक ही आदत से पैदा होती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen on a wide wooden desk in soft daylight showing one full document page where mismatched headings, uneven bullets and ragged spacing are all visible at once

scenes.narration: Manual formatting. Somebody selected a line, clicked Bold, then bumped the size.
scenes.caption: हाथ से फ़ॉर्मेटिंग। किसी ने पंक्ति चुनी, बोल्ड किया, आकार बढ़ाया।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing one line of document text selected, with the Bold button and the font size box in the toolbar above it lit up, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Word stored that as a private note on those exact characters.
scenes.caption: वर्ड ने उसे उन्हीं अक्षरों पर एक निजी निर्देश बना दिया।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing one bold, oversized phrase inside an otherwise plain paragraph, with small labels drawn beside the bold letters, soft daylight

scenes.narration: It never became a rule. It stayed a one-off.
scenes.caption: वह नियम नहीं बना, केवल एक बार का बदलाव रहा।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing a styles list in which every entry still looks untouched, while a line of document text below it is bold and oversized, soft daylight

scenes.narration: The next heading got its own, slightly different one-off.
scenes.caption: अगले शीर्षक को अपना, थोड़ा अलग बदलाव मिला।
scenes.image_brief: Three headings on the laptop screen, each a different size and weight, with plain paragraph text between them, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Fourteen headings, fourteen private notes, and no two of them alike.
scenes.caption: चौदह शीर्षक, चौदह निजी निर्देश, कोई दो एक जैसे नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A long document scrolled down on the laptop screen with fourteen headings visible, every one of them shaped differently, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Spacing is the same story. Enter pressed four times in a row.
scenes.caption: स्पेसिंग की भी वही कहानी। एंटर चार बार दबाया गया।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen with formatting marks turned on, four paragraph marks stacked in a column between two blocks of text, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Those empty paragraphs are content, not spacing. So they move.
scenes.caption: वे खाली पैराग्राफ़ सामग्री हैं, स्पेसिंग नहीं। वे खिसकते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Two copies of the same document page side by side on the laptop screen, stacked empty paragraph marks pushing a heading lower in the second copy, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Alignment fails for the same reason: spaces used instead of tabs.
scenes.caption: संरेखण भी इसी वजह से बिगड़ता है: टैब की जगह स्पेस।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen with formatting marks on, showing a column of numbers padded out by rows of space dots that do not line up, soft daylight

scenes.narration: A space changes width with every font, so the column drifts.
scenes.caption: हर फ़ॉन्ट में स्पेस की चौड़ाई बदलती है, कॉलम टेढ़ा हो जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: The same padded column of numbers shown twice on the laptop screen, straight in one typeface and ragged in another, soft daylight

scenes.narration: So which one wins, the style or the hand formatting?
scenes.caption: तो कौन जीतता है, स्टाइल या हाथ की फ़ॉर्मेटिंग?
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen on a wide wooden desk in soft daylight, showing the styles pane along one side and a heavily hand-formatted heading beside it

scenes.narration: Hand formatting wins. Every single time.
scenes.caption: हाथ की फ़ॉर्मेटिंग जीतती है। हर बार।
scenes.image_brief: A heading on the laptop screen still bold and oversized while the entry listed next to it in the styles pane shows a small, plain sample, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Before you touch anything, save a copy. Call it cleanup.
scenes.caption: कुछ बदलने से पहले एक प्रति सहेजें। नाम रखें cleanup।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop on a wide wooden desk in soft daylight showing a save dialog whose filename ends in cleanup, with the original document listed behind it

scenes.narration: Now turn on formatting marks. Ctrl plus Shift plus eight.
scenes.caption: अब फ़ॉर्मेटिंग चिह्न चालू करें। Ctrl + Shift + 8 दबाएँ।
scenes.image_brief: A keyboard in front of the laptop on a wide wooden desk in soft daylight, with the Ctrl, Shift and 8 keys highlighted and the document visible on the screen behind

scenes.narration: Every space, tab and paragraph mark becomes visible on the page.
scenes.caption: हर स्पेस, टैब और पैराग्राफ़ चिह्न पेज पर दिखने लगता है।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing a document page dense with visible dots, arrows and paragraph marks sitting between the words, soft daylight

scenes.narration: The mess is suddenly something you can actually see.
scenes.caption: गड़बड़ी अचानक आँखों के सामने दिखने लगती है।
scenes.image_brief: A printed page beside the laptop covered in visible formatting marks, with clusters of dots and stray paragraph marks along its margins, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Open the Styles pane with Ctrl, Alt, Shift and S.
scenes.caption: Ctrl + Alt + Shift + S से स्टाइल्स पैनल खोलें।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen with a styles pane open along its right edge listing Normal, Heading 1 and Heading 2, and document text on the left, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Scroll the whole file once. Note down every real heading.
scenes.caption: पूरी फ़ाइल एक बार देखें। हर असली शीर्षक नोट करें।
scenes.image_brief: A notebook and pen beside the laptop on a wide wooden desk in soft daylight, the notebook page holding a short handwritten list of heading names

scenes.narration: Decide your structure now: Title, Heading 1, Heading 2. Nothing more.
scenes.caption: ढाँचा अभी तय करें: Title, Heading 1, Heading 2। और कुछ नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: The notebook on a wide wooden desk in soft daylight showing a three-level outline drawn as an indented list, with the laptop open behind it

scenes.narration: Step one. Strip the hand formatting out completely.
scenes.caption: पहला चरण। हाथ की सारी फ़ॉर्मेटिंग पूरी तरह हटा दें।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing the full mismatched document page with a selection highlight covering every line of text, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Select the whole document with Ctrl plus A.
scenes.caption: Ctrl + A दबाकर पूरा दस्तावेज़ चुन लें।
scenes.image_brief: A keyboard on a wide wooden desk in soft daylight with the Ctrl and A keys highlighted, and the laptop screen behind it showing every line of the document selected

scenes.narration: Press Ctrl plus Spacebar. Character formatting resets to the default.
scenes.caption: Ctrl + Spacebar दबाएँ। अक्षर की फ़ॉर्मेटिंग डिफ़ॉल्ट पर लौटती है।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen where a page of mixed bold, coloured and oversized text has become one uniform typeface, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Press Ctrl plus Q. Paragraph formatting resets as well.
scenes.caption: Ctrl + Q दबाएँ। पैराग्राफ़ की फ़ॉर्मेटिंग भी रीसेट हो जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing paragraphs that were indented at different depths now all starting at the same left margin, soft daylight

scenes.narration: The document looks plain now, and a little bit wrong.
scenes.caption: दस्तावेज़ अब सादा लगता है, और थोड़ा ग़लत भी।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing a long, flat page of identical plain paragraphs with no visible headings anywhere, soft daylight

scenes.narration: That is progress. Every paragraph is Normal style again.
scenes.caption: यह प्रगति है। हर पैराग्राफ़ फिर Normal स्टाइल में है।
scenes.image_brief: The styles pane on the laptop screen with Normal highlighted, and the document next to it written entirely in that one setting, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Step two. Fix the base style, never the text itself.
scenes.caption: दूसरा चरण। आधार स्टाइल सुधारें, टेक्स्ट को नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen with the pointer resting on the Normal entry in the styles pane and plain document text alongside it, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Right-click Normal in the Styles pane and choose Modify.
scenes.caption: स्टाइल्स पैनल में Normal पर राइट-क्लिक करें, Modify चुनें।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing a small context menu opened over the Normal entry in the styles pane, with a Modify option listed inside it, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Set your font, size and line spacing right there. Once.
scenes.caption: वहीं फ़ॉन्ट, आकार और लाइन स्पेसिंग सेट करें। एक ही बार।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing a settings dialog with the font name, size and line spacing fields filled in, document page behind it, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Every paragraph updates together, and you selected nothing at all.
scenes.caption: हर पैराग्राफ़ साथ बदलता है, और आपने कुछ चुना ही नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing a long document where every paragraph now shares the same typeface and spacing, with no text selected, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Step three. Tag every heading by its level.
scenes.caption: तीसरा चरण। हर शीर्षक को उसके स्तर से चिह्नित करें।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing a plain document with the text cursor sitting at the start of one line that ought to be a heading, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Click into the first heading line. Press Ctrl, Alt, one.
scenes.caption: पहली शीर्षक पंक्ति में क्लिक करें। Ctrl + Alt + 1 दबाएँ।
scenes.image_brief: A keyboard on a wide wooden desk in soft daylight with the Ctrl, Alt and 1 keys highlighted, and the laptop screen behind showing one line becoming a large heading

scenes.narration: That line becomes Heading 1. Sub-headings all get Heading 2.
scenes.caption: वह पंक्ति Heading 1 बनती है। उप-शीर्षक Heading 2 लेते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing a page with one large heading and two smaller sub-headings beneath it, plain paragraphs in between, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Work down the document, heading by heading, to the end.
scenes.caption: दस्तावेज़ में नीचे तक, एक-एक शीर्षक करते जाएँ।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing a long document scrolled near its end, with tagged headings marked all the way down the page, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Do not adjust their look yet. You are labelling structure.
scenes.caption: उनका रूप अभी न बदलें। आप ढाँचा तय कर रहे हैं।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing several headings all in the same plain default heading appearance, differing only by size step, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Step four. Now change the look, one single time.
scenes.caption: चौथा चरण। अब रूप बदलें, केवल एक बार।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen with the Heading 1 entry in the styles pane selected and its context menu open beside it, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Modify Heading 1. Set the size, colour and space above.
scenes.caption: Heading 1 को Modify करें। आकार, रंग और ऊपर की जगह सेट करें।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing a heading settings dialog with the size, colour and space-above fields filled in, soft daylight

scenes.narration: All fourteen headings change at the same moment. That is styles.
scenes.caption: सभी चौदह शीर्षक एक ही पल में बदलते हैं। यही स्टाइल्स है।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing a long document with fourteen identical, evenly spaced headings running down the page, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Step five. Clear the stray spacing with Find and Replace.
scenes.caption: पाँचवाँ चरण। Find and Replace से बिखरी स्पेसिंग साफ़ करें।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing a find and replace dialog open over a document page dotted with visible space marks, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Press Ctrl plus H. Replace two spaces with one space.
scenes.caption: Ctrl + H दबाएँ। दो स्पेस की जगह एक स्पेस डालें।
scenes.image_brief: The find and replace dialog on the laptop screen with two space dots showing in the search field and a single dot in the replace field, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Run it again until Word reports zero replacements made.
scenes.caption: इसे तब तक चलाएँ जब तक वर्ड शून्य बदलाव न बताए।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing a small message box stating that no replacements were made, with the find and replace dialog behind it, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Then replace caret p caret p with a single caret p.
scenes.caption: फिर ^p^p की जगह केवल एक ^p डालें।
scenes.image_brief: The find and replace dialog on the laptop screen with a doubled paragraph code typed in the search field and a single one in the replace field, soft daylight

scenes.narration: That removes every empty paragraph in one clean pass.
scenes.caption: यह एक ही बार में हर खाली पैराग्राफ़ हटा देता है।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen with formatting marks on, showing a page where stacked paragraph marks have been reduced to one at each break, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Put the air back into Normal. Space After, eight points.
scenes.caption: हवा वापस Normal में डालें। Space After आठ पॉइंट रखें।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing the Normal settings dialog with a space-after value of eight points entered, and evenly spaced text behind it, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Step six. Delete the spaces someone used to indent lines.
scenes.caption: छठा चरण। इंडेंट के लिए लगाए गए स्पेस हटा दें।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen with formatting marks on, showing rows of space dots at the start of several lines being cleared away, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Set one tab stop on the ruler, then press Tab.
scenes.caption: रूलर पर एक टैब स्टॉप रखें, फिर Tab दबाएँ।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing the horizontal ruler above the document with a single tab stop marker on it, and a column of text lined up beneath, soft daylight

scenes.narration: For lists, apply a list style. Not typed dashes.
scenes.caption: सूचियों के लिए लिस्ट स्टाइल लगाएँ, टाइप किए डैश नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing a bulleted list where every bullet begins at the same indent, with the matching list entry highlighted in the styles pane, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Need a new page? Ctrl plus Enter. Never a row of Enters.
scenes.caption: नया पेज चाहिए? Ctrl + Enter दबाएँ। एंटर की कतार नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen with formatting marks on, showing a single labelled page break line at the bottom of one page instead of stacked paragraph marks, soft daylight

scenes.narration: So how do you know it actually worked?
scenes.caption: तो कैसे पता चलेगा कि यह सच में काम कर गया?
scenes.image_brief: The laptop on a wide wooden desk in soft daylight showing the cleaned document page with even headings and regular spacing from top to bottom

scenes.narration: Open the Navigation pane with Ctrl plus F.
scenes.caption: Ctrl + F से नेविगेशन पैनल खोलें।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen with a navigation pane open along the left edge listing the document headings as an indented tree, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Your headings should read there like a clean outline.
scenes.caption: वहाँ आपके शीर्षक एक साफ़ रूपरेखा जैसे दिखने चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: The navigation pane on the laptop screen showing a tidy two-level list of heading names, each sub-heading indented under its parent, soft daylight

scenes.narration: A line missing from that list is not a real heading.
scenes.caption: उस सूची से ग़ायब पंक्ति असली शीर्षक नहीं है।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing the navigation pane beside the document, with one bold-looking line in the text absent from the pane list, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Click any paragraph and watch the Styles pane highlight one name.
scenes.caption: किसी पैराग्राफ़ पर क्लिक करें, स्टाइल्स पैनल में एक नाम उजागर होगा।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing the text cursor inside a paragraph while exactly one entry in the styles pane is highlighted, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Turn formatting marks on again and scan for double marks.
scenes.caption: फ़ॉर्मेटिंग चिह्न फिर चालू करें और दोहरे चिह्न खोजें।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen with formatting marks on, showing a page where a single paragraph mark ends each paragraph and no dots crowd the margins, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Insert a table of contents. If it builds, the structure is real.
scenes.caption: विषय-सूची डालें। बन जाए तो ढाँचा सच में तैयार है।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing a generated table of contents page with heading names and page numbers in two neat levels, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Some documents should not be cleaned up this way.
scenes.caption: कुछ दस्तावेज़ों की सफ़ाई इस तरीक़े से नहीं करनी चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: A closed laptop on a wide wooden desk in soft daylight with a stack of printed pages resting on top of it and a hand-written warning note clipped to the stack

scenes.narration: Stop if the file is a legal or regulated template.
scenes.caption: रुकें, अगर फ़ाइल कोई क़ानूनी या नियमित टेम्पलेट है।
scenes.image_brief: A printed form on a wide wooden desk in soft daylight with numbered clauses, ruled signature boxes and a stamp block along its lower edge

scenes.narration: The exact layout can be part of the official record.
scenes.caption: ठीक वही लेआउट रिकॉर्ड का हिस्सा हो सकता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two identical printed forms side by side on a wide wooden desk in soft daylight, their clause numbers and margins matching line for line

scenes.narration: Ask the owner of the document first.
scenes.caption: पहले दस्तावेज़ के मालिक से पूछ लें।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop on a wide wooden desk in soft daylight showing an unsent short message window open above the document, with the document greyed out behind it

scenes.narration: Stop if the document is under tracked-changes review.
scenes.caption: रुकें, अगर दस्तावेज़ ट्रैक्ड चेंजेज़ समीक्षा में है।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing a document with coloured revision marks and change balloons stacked along the right margin, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Ctrl plus A, then Ctrl plus Q, creates hundreds of revisions.
scenes.caption: Ctrl + A और फिर Ctrl + Q सैकड़ों संशोधन बना देते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing a document page almost entirely covered in coloured revision marks, with a dense stack of change balloons at the side, soft daylight

scenes.narration: It buries the real comments your reviewers left behind.
scenes.caption: यह समीक्षकों की असली टिप्पणियों को दबा देता है।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing a long column of change balloons in which two written comment bubbles are almost hidden among formatting entries, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Stop if the file is full of linked objects.
scenes.caption: रुकें, अगर फ़ाइल में बहुत सारी जुड़ी वस्तुएँ हैं।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing a document page carrying an embedded chart, a data table and a numbered figure caption, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Stripping paragraph formatting can shift charts, captions and tables.
scenes.caption: पैराग्राफ़ फ़ॉर्मेटिंग हटाने से चार्ट, कैप्शन और टेबल खिसक सकते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen showing the same document page twice, with an embedded chart and its caption sitting in different places in the second version, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Stop if you skipped the copy. Go back and save one.
scenes.caption: रुकें, अगर प्रति नहीं सहेजी। पहले जाकर सहेजें।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop on a wide wooden desk in soft daylight showing a folder listing that holds only one document file and no cleanup copy beside it

scenes.narration: Never do this on a file someone else has open.
scenes.caption: जो फ़ाइल किसी और ने खोली है, उस पर यह न करें।
scenes.image_brief: Two laptops on the same wide wooden desk in soft daylight, both screens showing the identical shared document page open at once

scenes.narration: And for two short paragraphs? Formatting by hand is fine.
scenes.caption: और दो छोटे पैराग्राफ़ के लिए? हाथ से फ़ॉर्मेट करना ठीक है।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop screen on a wide wooden desk in soft daylight, showing a nearly empty document that holds just two short paragraphs of text

scenes.narration: Open one document you inherited. Turn on formatting marks.
scenes.caption: कोई एक विरासत में मिला दस्तावेज़ खोलें। चिह्न चालू करें।
scenes.image_brief: The laptop on a wide wooden desk in soft daylight showing an old inherited document page with formatting marks switched on and dots visible between the words

scenes.narration: Count the empty paragraphs. That number is your starting point.
scenes.caption: खाली पैराग्राफ़ गिनें। वही संख्या आपकी शुरुआत है।
scenes.image_brief: The notebook on a wide wooden desk in soft daylight beside the laptop with a tally of counted marks written on its page and the marked-up document on the screen
